_comment: Manual queue for the DMA Jobs Discord agent. Jobs here are approved to post but NOT yet posted (Discord is firewalled from the cloud sandbox; posting happens via browser or the Apps Script relay). After a job is posted, move its entry into posted-jobs.json with the date.
_note: Staged 2026-08-11. Three cap-passing, verified-live roles ready to post the moment Chrome is connected. Deduped against posted-jobs.json. Post as the Digital Media Jobs bot via webhook; only move to posted-jobs.json after a real HTTP 204.

queue.title: Video Editor & Motion Designer, ScaleMath (Remote)
queue.description: **Portfolio-first remote video and motion role.** Edit long-form footage (tutorials, case studies, webinars, podcast) into tight, high-retention videos and build clean motion graphics such as lower thirds, callouts, and transitions in Premiere Pro and After Effects.
queue.cap_note: No degree required, no minimum years stated, hired on 2 to 4 work samples. Clears the no-degree cap.

queue.title: Animator / Motion Designer, Unexplainable (Part-time, Temporary), Vox Media (Remote)
queue.description: **Motion design for a Vox video podcast.** Build the graphics package and weekly animations in After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator, with Premiere familiarity a plus. 20 hours per week on a one-year contract at $37 to $45 per hour, portfolio required.
queue.cap_note: No degree required, 3 to 4 years design/animation experience sits inside the no-degree cap of up to 4 years.

queue.title: Junior Graphic Designer, Homebound (Hybrid, TX/FL/CA)
queue.description: **True entry-level graphic design.** Design marketing collateral, social assets, and Canva templates across print and digital in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign), with Figma a plus. Hybrid in Dallas or Houston TX, Tampa or St. Petersburg FL, or Los Angeles CA.
queue.cap_note: Explicitly entry-level (internship/freelance only a plus), Bachelor's preferred not required. Clears both the entry-level rule and the degree rule.
